display.purpose: Playfair Bold 26/32 for public discovery titles and vendor identity only.

pageTitle.purpose: Inter Bold 24/30 across Public, Vendor, and Admin task surfaces.

headline.purpose: Inter Bold 20/26; Playfair at the same size only for intentional public editorial emphasis.

title.purpose: Inter Bold 16/21, with Playfair 18/23 reserved for media-led vendor identity.

body.purpose: Inter Regular 13/20, or 12/18 in dense operational layouts.

metadata.purpose: Inter Regular 11/16 for dates, locations, counts, prices, and secondary facts.

label.purpose: Inter Semibold 11/15 for fields, chips, badges, and compact controls.

tab.purpose: Inter Semibold 12/17 for navigation and segmented controls.

caption.purpose: Inter Medium 10/14; the minimum functional text size.

hierarchyRule.purpose: Prefer spacing, weight, color, and grouping before size; functional titles max at 24px and editorial titles at 26px.

components.name: Primary Button

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quiet action on blush with strong rose text and the same tactile geometry.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid #FBCFE8; border-radius: 14px; background: #FCE7F3; color: #BE185D; font: 700 12px/16px Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: opacity 120ms ease, transform 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #FBCFE8; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { opacity: .9; transform: scale(.98); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(233,30,99,.24); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Warm paper field with a petal border that resolves to Bridal Pink on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: #1F191C; font: 700 10px/1.4 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 49px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #FBCFE8; border-radius: 14px; background: #FFFBFC; color: #1F191C; font: 400 13px/1.5 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; outline: none; transition: border-color 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: #F3A7C8; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: #E91E63; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(233,30,99,.12); }

components.name: Selection Chip
components.description: Compact fully rounded metadata or filtering control; selected state becomes decisively pink.
components.css: .ds-chip { min-height: 32px; padding: 6px 10px; border: 1px solid #FBCFE8; border-radius: 999px; background: #E91E63; color: #FFFFFF; font: 700 10px/1.4 Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: opacity 120ms ease, transform 120ms ease; } .ds-chip:hover { opacity: .92; } .ds-chip:active { transform: scale(.98); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(233,30,99,.24); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: RoyalLagn pairs the romance and visual confidence of a contemporary wedding publication with the clarity of a trusted marketplace. Photography and video lead on discovery surfaces; blush framing, precise pink accents, and selective Playfair Display typography give that media an unmistakably wedding-focused setting without competing with it. Operational surfaces for vendors and administrators are denser and primarily Inter-led. They retain the same warm palette, rounded geometry, and tactile feedback, but reduce decoration so profiles, enquiries, billing, moderation, and CRM work remain fast to scan. The public, vendor, and admin experiences are related members of one family, not identical skins. Depth is softly layered: clean white or midnight page canvases support pink-tinted cards, tonal inset surfaces, and restrained ambient shadows. Controls feel refined and tactile through clear states and short press responses rather than ornamental animation.
keyCharacteristics: Media-forward public discovery with an editorial serif accent.
Bridal pink used as a deliberate action and selection signal.
Warm blush neutrals in light mode and midnight blue-black surfaces in dark mode.
Rounded, approachable silhouettes with fine borders and restrained elevation.
Compact operational density for vendor and admin workflows.

rules.name: The Pink Signal Rule
rules.body: Bridal Pink identifies actions, selection, focus, and meaningful brand moments; avoid washing entire screens in saturated pink.

rules.name: The Media Leads Rule
rules.body: On discovery surfaces, photographs and video carry the emotional color. UI colors frame the media rather than compete with it.

rules.name: The Editorial Accent Rule
rules.body: Use Playfair selectively on public discovery and vendor storytelling; use Inter for transactional and operational clarity. Never set dense forms or dashboards primarily in the serif.

rules.name: The Soft Layer Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy with canvas, surface, border, and inset tint first; add a shadow only when a surface must visibly float.

dos: Do preserve the semantic light/dark palette and use Bridal Pink as a meaningful signal.
Do let wedding photography and Clips provide the emotional richness on public surfaces.
Do use Playfair for selective editorial emphasis and Inter for UI clarity.
Do keep public, vendor, and admin surfaces visibly related while respecting their different densities and jobs.
Do use fine borders, tonal layers, and brief tactile states before adding stronger shadows or motion.
Do preserve minimum touch targets, safe areas, keyboard behavior, accessibility state, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't introduce generic Material blue, cool gray defaults, or an unrelated component-library theme.
Don't make every surface pink; saturated pink loses authority when it becomes background noise.
Don't flatten vendor/admin tools into decorative consumer cards or make public discovery feel like a back-office dashboard.
Don't use Playfair for dense forms, metadata, tables, or small operational labels.
Don't introduce bouncy, long-distance, looping, or navigation-blocking motion.
Don't replace the rounded editorial identity with sharp enterprise geometry or excessively pill-shaped containers.
